description: Bring a plain text file (.txt, UTF-8) into the document: into a new point or area text frame at x, y, or replacing the text of one frame (File > Place for text). Line breaks become paragraphs

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

layer.description: Layer for a new frame. Default: the active layer

target.description: One text frame whose text is replaced. Omit to make a new frame at x, y

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

width.description: New area text frame width; omit for point text

x.description: New frame: left, in points from the artboard

y.description: New frame: top (area text) or first baseline (point text)

name: import_text
title: Import Text
